prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 常用化学试剂清单 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "名称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "分子式" · longest unbreakable word 135px · one-line width 135px
  col 3: header "CAS 号" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 78px
  col 4: header "纯度" · longest unbreakable word 54px · one-line width 135px
  col 5: header "储存条件（长）" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 1145px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"供读者识别常用化学试剂，并查阅其纯度和储存要求。","reading":"读者先按名称定位试剂，再横向核对分子式、CAS 号和纯度，最后阅读储存条件；储存说明较长，通常决定行高。","groups":["名称、分子式和 CAS 号共同用于识别试剂，其中后两列是需要准确核对的标识。","纯度和储存条件描述试剂规格与保管要求，需与同一行的试剂保持清晰对应。"],"keep_intact":["分子式及其下标、结晶水记法","CAS 号","纯度百分比和范围","名称尽量完整，尤其是较长的乙二胺四乙酸二钠"],"may_wrap":["储存条件可在自然语义位置换行，其产生的行高也可容纳同一行其他单元格的换行。","纯度等级与百分比之间可以换行。","空间紧张时，较长的中文试剂名称可以换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [100, 156, 99, 96, 268] · table 720×919px · row heights [36, 129, 129, 129, 129, 106, 129, 129] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [115, 156, 99, 96, 253] · table 720×965px · row heights [36, 129, 129, 129, 153, 129, 129, 129] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [144, 156, 99, 96, 224] · table 720×1082px · row heights [36, 153, 153, 153, 153, 129, 153, 153] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"储存列较宽，说明多为五行，行高较紧凑；分子式、CAS 号及纯度数值完整，表头均为一行。","problems":"长名称折成两行，断在“乙”和“酸”之间；储存说明仍有跨行切开的词组，但各行与对应试剂的关系清楚。","cause":"名称列 100px 仅提供 79px 内容宽度；储存列 268px 仍不足以容纳整句长说明。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"标识和纯度数值完整，名称列比 r2A 稍宽，长名称的第一行容纳更多字。","problems":"长名称仍分两行；丙酮的“5–25”和“°C”分离，储存说明出现六行，表格比 r2A 更高。","cause":"名称列 115px 仍不足以容纳完整长名称；储存列缩至 253px，使温度及其他说明在较窄行宽处换行。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"所有名称保持一行，分子式、CAS 号及纯度数值完整，定位试剂容易。","problems":"储存说明明显拥挤，几乎每行都达到六行，30 与 °C 也分开；左侧短内容下方留下更多空白，整表纵向扫描距离增大。","cause":"名称列增至 144px，换取完整长名称，但储存列因此缩至 224px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"storage-first","widths":[100,156,99,96,268],"change":"以 r2A 为基准，把 1px 从名称列移至储存列，满足 719px 上限；保留较宽的储存说明，同时允许长名称换行。"},{"name":"balanced-name","widths":[114,156,99,90,260],"change":"适度加宽名称列，并从纯度列回收 6px 给储存列；纯度内容宽度仍有 69px，可容纳最长百分比范围，检验长名称与储存说明之间的折中。"},{"name":"intact-name","widths":[144,156,99,75,245],"change":"保留完整名称，将纯度列缩至 75px，恰好为最长不可拆分数值留出 54px 内容宽度；把节省的宽度给储存列，检验名称完整与说明可读性的另一种平衡。"}]}
